predecessor.historical_note: K4M used consumed DEV19 only to diagnose lost FIT8; do not select fit examples with K4L DEV information.

source.frozen_predictor: Use exact K4I nearest-neighbor armwise reward predictor, unmodified 128D public reset features and frozen K4K coverage/outcome-aware/uniform selectors.

cohort.task_constructor: K4H public source-supported goal dx/dy shifts; actions K4H low, center, high, even0.2/odd0.8 on nine joints

mechanism.description: Task-family-specific original-record-only, 4 FIT exemplars/arm chosen via deterministic greedy swaps to preserve full FIT policy action choices and predicted action returns. No hidden parameters, task offsets or K4L DEV action labels.
mechanism.initialization: exact original frozen K4K coverage_4 coreset for each action, each family
mechanism.fitting_phase: For each family use its 12 FIT public reset observations and four actual action rewards per context only; fit full 12 per arm to the same FIT episodes.
mechanism.normalized_loss: 1000 times number of FIT-context action disagreements with full memory plus sum across 12 FIT contexts and four arms of |full_original_predicted_reward - compressed_predicted_reward| divided by max(1, maxFITreward-minFITreward). Reward-prediction calculations use only original FIT rows and unchanged squared-distance 1NN.
mechanism.search: At most 8 greedy strict-improvement 1-for-1 swaps per family. For each arm 0..3, each retained slot 0..3, each unretained FIT variant in ascending order, compute frozen normalized loss. Choose globally lowest loss, ties lexicographic arm, removed FIT variant, added FIT variant. Stop if improvement <=1e-12. Sort selected original records by FIT variant after each swap.
mechanism.no_hindsight: Absolutely no K4L/K4M DEV reward or K4N CHECK/DEV reward enters selection. FIT-only calculation allowed; frozen source comparator is full 1NN policy on the same FIT conditions, not a transfer guarantee.
mechanism.model_cap: 4 unchanged original FIT source records per action, no generated examples or reward labels. Report swap trace, final record identities and original FIT-only loss delta.
mechanism.baseline_controls: Equal memory budget: coverage-only 4, outcome-aware 4, uniform 4. Higher capacity full 12 1NN, trained constant family best mean, original ridge and fixed low.
mechanism.training_prerequisite: For reaching, at least 12 unique public FIT reset observations and >=2 distinct best realized legal actions; otherwise stop without any CHECK/DEV actions/rewards.
mechanism.holdout_boundary: Compute all heldout policy decisions using reset-only public observations and saved fitted states BEFORE collecting any CHECK/DEV action reward. For each new variant, the four arm rollouts must begin at byte-identical public reset observations.

scientific_rules.preregistered_primary: fit_fidelity_4, no best-model selection from DEV
scientific_rules.DEV_outcomes: 8 reaching and 8 pushing novel configurations, strict no reuse of prior K4I/J/K/L offsets
scientific_rules.positive: On fresh reaching DEV the proposed coreset must choose >=2 distinct actions, strictly beat fully fitted family_mean on at least 3/8 variants, exceed its mean reward by >=0.01, retain >=90% of full12's positive gain, and beat BOTH equal-capacity coverage4 and outcomeaware4 in mean reward by >=0.01. Full12 must have positive mean gain. Source diagnostic must show >=2 offline best-action IDs on reaching DEV. Checkpoint bytes <=50% full12, inference CPU <=65% full12. Every criterion for each independent OS process required.
scientific_rules.report: No-go even if size/speed positive but contextual decision quality insufficient; preserve exact per-world returns, action choices, fitted state and source pins; two OS processes must agree except timings.
scientific_rules.resources: Measure 200 passes x 20 public holdout contexts per method, 4000 total choices per method, per-method CPU/wall and model bytes; shared training/full physics run CPU/wall/RSS. No claim of complete per-method total-energy accounting.
scientific_rules.multiple_comparisons: Only fit_fidelity_4 prespecified as primary; all other methods are frozen controls. No retrospective selection for acceptance.
